## Assignment Options

::: {.callout-note title="Mechanics Focus"}
The base assignment treats the shaft as an overhanging beam under known transverse pulley resultants. Shaft torsion, diameter selection, bending stress, fatigue, dynamics, and local hub or keyway effects are intentionally excluded.
:::
